title: TC-E2E-009: backward audit traceability from outcome to originating signal (mocked SoR)
risk: Nobody can explain a completed customer-visible action: the audit trail is assembled from memory, a link is missing, or a tampered evidence row is accepted as proof.
preconditions: run_id=RUN-E2E-OFF-TRACE, case_id=E2E-OFF-TRACE, worker=w-biz-e2e; one complete run (signal evt_a_cart_add_1 -> order ORD-A-1) is executed first so the audit trail exists before the walk begins
the chain verifier uses the HMAC secret injected for this run (never a hard-coded literal) and the walk is read-only apart from the deliberate tamper probe

inputs.negative_probe: tamper one middle evidence payload after the run
inputs.chain_secret_ref: AUDIT_HMAC_SECRET from the case environment (not in repo)

steps.action: Complete one run and record its identifiers
steps.expected: the run ends completed with one run_id/correlation_id and the order ORD-A-1; the outcome watch is registered for the effect_key

outcome attribution -> evidence record -> execution receipt -> authority verdict -> decision -> context -> originating signal each resolve to a persisted row carrying the identical run_id and correlation_id

steps.action: Verify the hash chain end to end
steps.expected: every evidence row's previous_evidence_hash equals its predecessor's chain_hash and every row's HMAC verifies with the injected secret, with no unchained entry
the walk shows the authority verdict that authorised the step (AUTH-3 auto path) and distinguishes it from a missing approval rather than leaving a silent gap
after one middle evidence payload is tampered with, the chain verification fails and the walk reports the identified broken link instead of returning a truncated trace

steps.action: Re-read the trace after a process restart
steps.expected: the same chain is reproduced from the persisted stores alone, proving the trace is not a reconstruction from in-memory objects

assertions: every hop of the backward walk resolves to a persisted record with the identical run_id, from the outcome back to the originating signal (TC-E2E-009)
the evidence hash chain verifies end to end with the injected secret, and a tampered or missing middle row fails verification instead of yielding a partial trace
decisions in the chain carry reason + evidence rather than prose alone (NFR-005), and the authority verdict that authorised the step is recorded
the trace is reproducible from persisted state after a restart and never assembled from caches or from the model's account of what happened
forbidden: presenting a trace built from in-memory objects or from the agent's own narrative
silently skipping a missing link, or rewriting an immutable audit/evidence row to make the chain look complete
evidence: the full ordered chain with row ids, payload digests and chain hashes for the run
chain verification report (per-row HMAC plus previous-hash linkage)
negative-probe report identifying the tampered row and the failed link
cleanup: restore the tampered probe row and drop run RUN-E2E-OFF-TRACE from the mock stores; the original chained audit and evidence rows are immutable and are retained
automation: Real code under test: skill registry row, authority guard/PEP, input validator, deadline and retry loop, effect_key reservation + reconciliation, evidence/audit writer. Substituted boundary: the external adapter (in-memory for offline, approved sandbox for live). Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; all waits are condition/deadline waits on the engine's virtual clock, never sleep. The audit writer, evidence hash chain and the trace reader are real; the order connector is the substituted boundary and the audit stores are in-memory but read exactly as the persisted ones are.
